<title>New Spirit Dakhla Hotel at Dakhla Lagoon</title>
  <meta name="description" content="New Spirit Dakhla is an authentic hotel designed for kitesurfers and wing foilers seeking reliable wind, flat water, and relaxed comfort. Located directly at the Dakhla Lagoon, it offers immediate access to one of the world’s best kite and wingfoil spots. Comfortable bungalows, restaurant, pool and pool bar create the perfect balance between time on the water and recovery. Ideal for beginners, advanced riders, kite camps, and extended stays at Dakhla Lagoon in Morocco."/>

class="comp-mh214sfa-container"><!--$--><div id="comp-mh21c9fr" role="" class="HFEOE3 NaeT1r comp-mh21c9fr-container comp-mh21c9fr wixui-box" dir="ltr"><div aria-hidden="true" class="jdJeEr NYfD3h wixui-rich-text__text">Hotel</h4></div><!--/$--></div><!--/$--><!--$--><div id="comp-mh21c9g3" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-mh21c9g3 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text">Set on a terraced hillside overlooking the northwest of Dakhla&rsquo;s lagoon, the newly designed bungalow hotel and its exclusive Kitesurf &amp; Wingfoil Center &mdash; powered by KBC World &mdash; offer an unmatched blend of style, comfort, and location.</p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
A private sandy beachfront and dedicated watersports area create a seamless &ldquo;bed-to-buffet-to-board&rdquo; experience. After riding, guests gather at the pool or the pool bar to unwind in an atmosphere of effortless elegance and warm community spirit.</p></div><!--/$--></div><!--/$--></div></div><!--/$--><!--$--><div id="comp-mh214sfe" role="" class="HFEOE3 NaeT1r comp-mh214sfe wixui-box" dir="ltr"><div aria-hidden="true" class="jdJeEr NYfD3h inner-box wixui-box"></div><div data-testid="responsive-container-content" role="group" class="comp-mh214sfe-container"><!--$--><div id="comp-mh21nbg5" role="" class="HFEOE3 NaeT1r comp-mh21nbg5-container comp-mh21nbg5 wixui-box" dir="ltr"><div aria-hidden="true" class="jdJeEr NYfD3h inner-box wixui-box"></div><!--$--><div id="comp-mh21nbgh" role="" class="HFEOE3 NaeT1r comp-mh21nbgh-container comp-mh21nbgh wixui-box" dir="ltr"><div aria-hidden="true" class="jdJeEr NYfD3h inner-box wixui-box"></div><!--$--><div id="comp-mh21nbgk" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-mh21nbgk wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h4 class="font_4 wixui-rich-text__text">Bungalows</h4></div><!--/$--></div><!--/$--><!--$--><div id="comp-mh21nbgm2" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-mh21nbgm2 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text"><a href="mailto:booking@NewSpiritDakhla.com" target="_self" class="wixui-rich-text__text">31 cozy chalets in three categories:</a><br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
